dictionary.markdown:
For a set $A$ of positive integers and a real number $b>1$, write
$$
X_A(b)=\sum_{a\in A}\frac1{b^a-1}.
$$
dictionary.name: Erdos249257.erdosSupportSeries
dictionary.words: The Lambert subseries: the sum of 1/(b^a - 1) over a in A. In Lean the exponent 0 contributes 0, since division by 0 gives 0.
